propositions: Unchecked acceptance criteria checkboxes (- [ ]) block ticket close deterministically before LLM verifier dispatch, unless marked [operator-attested].

A precheck is added to the close transition path that parses the Acceptance Criteria section and rejects closes with unchecked non-attested boxes, reusing the existing operator-attested tag matcher regex.
Checkboxes bearing the [operator-attested] tag (case-insensitive) are exempt from blocking close and must not trigger false rejections.
Tickets closed via non-completion classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) and descriptions without checkbox syntax bypass the new precheck unchanged.
Historical verifier-passed closes, including those with attested-shaped items, must continue to pass the new deterministic precheck.
